characteristic_uuid.docs:
**UUID**: UUID of the service's characteristic to write to.

*See also: [BLE Client](https://esphome.io/components/ble_client#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: ID of the associated BLE client.

*See also: [BLE Client](https://esphome.io/components/ble_client#configuration-variables)*

service_uuid.docs:
**UUID**: UUID of the service to write to.

*See also: [BLE Client](https://esphome.io/components/ble_client#configuration-variables)*

value.docs:
**list of bytes**: The value to be written.

*See also: [BLE Client](https://esphome.io/components/ble_client#configuration-variables)*

ble_write.docs: This action triggers a write to a specified BLE characteristic. The write is attempted in a best-effort fashion and will only succeed if the `ble_client`  's connection has been established and the peripheral exposes the expected BLE service and characteristic. Execution of the automation block sequence resumes after the write has completed. A write failure will *not* stop execution of succeeding actions (this allows a disconnect to be executed, for example.)

connect.docs: This action is useful only for devices with `auto_connect: false` and allows a connection to be made from within an automation. Once connected other actions like `ble_write` can be used. This is useful where a BLE server needs only to be interacted with occasionally, and thus does not need a constant connection held.

disconnect.docs: This action disconnects a device that was connected with the `ble_client.connect` action. Execution of the automation block sequence resumes after the disconnect has completed.

accept.docs:
**boolean**: Should be `true` if the passkeys displayed on both BLE devices are matching.

*See also: [BLE Client](https://esphome.io/components/ble_client#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: ID of the associated BLE client.

*See also: [BLE Client](https://esphome.io/components/ble_client#configuration-variables)*

numeric_comparison_reply.docs: This action triggers an authentication attempt after a numeric comparison.

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: ID of the associated BLE client.

*See also: [BLE Client](https://esphome.io/components/ble_client#configuration-variables)*

passkey_reply.docs: This action triggers an authentication attempt using the specified `passkey`.

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: ID of the associated BLE client.

*See also: [BLE Client](https://esphome.io/components/ble_client#configuration-variables)*

remove_bond.docs: This action removes a device from the security database and manages unpairing.

ble_client_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: ID of the associated BLE client.

*See also: [PVVX MiThermometer Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/pvvx_mithermometer#configuration-variables)*

auto_connect.docs:
**boolean**: If true the device will be automatically connected when found by the [Esp32 Ble Tracker](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_ble_tracker/). Defaults to true.

*See also: [BLE Client](https://esphome.io/components/ble_client#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID to use for code generation, and for reference by dependent components.

*See also: [BLE Client Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ble_client#configuration-variables)*

mac_address.docs:
**MAC Address**: The MAC address of the BLE device to connect to.

*See also: [BLE Client](https://esphome.io/components/ble_client#configuration-variables)*

on_connect.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the client connects to a device. See [`on_connect`](https://esphome.io/components/ble_client#ble_client-on_connect).

*See also: [BLE Client](https://esphome.io/components/ble_client#configuration-variables)*

on_disconnect.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the client disconnects from a device. See [`on_disconnect`](https://esphome.io/components/ble_client#ble_client-on_disconnect).

*See also: [BLE Client](https://esphome.io/components/ble_client#configuration-variables)*

on_numeric_comparison_request.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to compare the passkeys shown on the two BLE devices. See [`on_numeric_comparison_request`](https://esphome.io/components/ble_client#ble_client-on_numeric_comparison_request).

*See also: [BLE Client](https://esphome.io/components/ble_client#configuration-variables)*

on_passkey_notification.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to display the passkey to the user. See [`on_passkey_notification`](https://esphome.io/components/ble_client#ble_client-on_passkey_notification).

*See also: [BLE Client](https://esphome.io/components/ble_client#configuration-variables)*

on_passkey_request.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to enter the passkey required by the other BLE device. See [`on_passkey_request`](https://esphome.io/components/ble_client#ble_client-on_passkey_request).

*See also: [BLE Client](https://esphome.io/components/ble_client#configuration-variables)*
